cold.name: Cold signal
cold.words: cold minimalist sci-fi horror, PS1-era low-poly look rendered as a flat image, muted teal, grey and bone white with deep red accents, film grain, faint CRT scanlines, one stark light source, lonely and melancholic
cold.avoid: cartoon, cute, bright cheerful colours, glossy, cluttered detail, text, watermark

neon.name: Neon cinema

neon.avoid: cartoon, cute, flat lighting, pastel, text, watermark

oil.name: Oil and grief
oil.words: expressionist oil painting, thick visible brush strokes and palette-knife texture, muted earthy ochres, greys and teals with bold accents, painterly light, world-weary and literary
oil.avoid: cartoon, cel shading, clean vector, cute, glossy 3d render, text, watermark, signature, frame

classic.name: Classic 16-bit
